text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Passing the fourth corner!
They've turned into the homestretch!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (I'll end it—right here!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOOOOOOAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—In the lead is Katsuragi Ace!!!
Katsuragi Ace crosses the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
S-So strong~~...!
Is this really the kind of race
Katsuragi Ace runs...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
At middle distance, she feels totally unbeatable~!
Looks like she could go toe-to-toe with C.B....!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeah!!!
You see that?! That's Katsuragi Ace for ya!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Both my body and mind feel completely fulfilled...!
Right now, I don't feel like I'd lose to anyone at medium distance!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hurry back, CB...! 
I've gotten stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, in a manner truly befitting of
one staking a claim as the strongest middle-distance runner,
Katsuragi Ace's Takarazuka Kinen came to an end—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: ――So, you'll finally be making your full comeback starting this autumn season...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I haven't decided which race
I'll start with yet, but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
For now, I definitely want to run the
Tenno Sho (Autumn).
...It sounds like it'll be interesting.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Oooooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The announcement of Mr. C.B.'s return sent waves of excitement through the public...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
""CB's comeback is finally here!!
Man, I've been waiting for this moment forever!!
Hurry up and show us that running style again~!""

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"‘CB really has a different aura from other Umamusume, or like, true star power.
I mean, just announcing her return caused this huge commotion.’"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is gonna be so exciting!
The Senior Class is really heating up~!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!!!
choice_data_list: Alright, next let's aim for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
Yeah, let's aim for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) next!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That was quick!! As expected of you~!!
You totally get it!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's show CB, and the whole world! That I am, without a doubt, the undisputed strongest at middle distance!! That "Katsuragi Ace is right here"!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
I'll make this the most blazing race ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace right now possesses more than
enough "prestige" to stand as Mr. C.B.'s rival
in medium-distance races...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The public is bound to watch the clash
between the two of them with burning excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"—When talking about the Twinkle Series today,
she is undoubtedly the central figure
you simply cannot overlook!"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf, victor of the recent Japanese Derby! Undefeated up to this point!
The only jewel left for the Triple Crown is the Kikuka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Show Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"No, what's truly amazing is that she declared she'd win the Triple Crown right at the start of the year.
And on top of that, undefeated. Has there ever been an Umamusume like this before?"

text_block_list.name: Show Commentator B
text_block_list.text: "I haven't really watched much of the Twinkle Series before, but her performances have been so incredible that I just couldn't help following her."

text_block_list.name: Show Commentator A
text_block_list.text: "Not to mention her race record, her demeanor is just overwhelmingly cool, you know~? Yeah, that must be what they call true charisma."

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: "On social media as well, Symboli Rudolf continues to hold the top trending spot regarding the Twinkle Series—"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text: "Rudolf is seriously incredible! I wanna see her win the Triple Crown and become a legend so bad!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text: "If Symboli Rudolf keeps winning like this, you can't help but get hyped~. Who knows, maybe she's got a real shot at this year's Arima?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text: "Man, I can't wait to see it!!"

text_block_list.name: Pervasive Public Expectations
text_block_list.text: "Mr. C.B. versus Symboli Rudolf!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah...――
Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry.
Can I stay here just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: It cools my head off... and it's quiet.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I used to be pretty confident
in my mental toughness, but—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "I guess... I'm more shocked than even I realized..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Less like shocked, and more like...
Well... frustrated, I guess—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...'Mr. C.B. nears her comeback in the
Tenno Sho (Autumn). Show us that unorthodox
running style of yours once more'â

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Will Japan finally claim its first victory in this year's Japan Cup? Will the crown go to a revived C.B., or the 'Emperor' of the new era, Symboli Rudolf?"—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Everywhere I look, to the right and to the left.
It's all about C.B. and Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ………………Where the heck—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Where the heck is my name...?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Autumn) ain't just some race set up for CB's comeback...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B.'s rival ain't Symboli Rudolf... !!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Acknowledge me...! Acknowledge Katsuragi Ace...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That I'm "not on equal footing" with them?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare write them off as being from "another world"!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ............Don't go jumping to conclusions... dammit—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I'm okay now.
...I feel refreshed."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...After this, all I have to do is prove everything
at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ......Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the sound of rain drumming against the umbrella,
I kept thinking about what I could do for Katsuragi Ace—
